Chapter 1092: 22: Stepping Into Domination (Subscription Requested)_2

Chapter 1092: Chapter 22: Stepping Into Domination (Subscription Requested)_2

The other party, however, did not have ambitions of becoming an emperor, but was wholly immersed in cultivation.

Not every member of the ancient royal family desires to be emperor.

“If Spirit Might King calls upon his brother, things will get difficult.”

Great Venerate Hongye said with a frown.

As a key member of the royal family, their combat power has always been able to dominate those at the same level.

And Spirit Might King’s brother is at the level of Great Lord.

Once such a powerful being takes action, unless Fierce Sun Ancient Country sends out a Great Lord from the core royal family, or directly dispatches a Heavenly Venerate-level figure, they will basically be unstoppable.

“Spirit Might King’s brother is a core royal family member, most likely he won’t act easily.”

A Great Lord pointed out, although the core royal family’s Great Lord is not a Heavenly Venerate, they’re almost there. Mobilizing such level beings could significantly increase the intensity of a war.

“No matter what, we must prevent the worst-case scenario.”

Lord Qingfen, however, did not relax his vigilance, planning to request aid from ‘Red Pine King’.

Red Pine King is the royal family royally appointed to lead this war from the Fierce Sun Ancient Country.

In this war, Lord Qingfen is definitely the Great Lord most unwilling to lose. Once Qingfen Domain falls, the foundations he has built over the years will be gone.

Even if the Fierce Sun Ancient Country gives him another territory, he would have to start anew, and the cost is enormous.

…

Chaos Void.

Star Tears ‘Fragment World’.

Within a manor.

Lin Yuan appeared, looking at Lin Shoucheng and Lu Qiong.

“Xiaoyuan, why have you come?” Mother Lu Qiong turned, surprised, and smiled: “You are now a myth in our human civilization, even when compared to the nine supreme beings…”

After moving to the new home, Lin Yuan’s prestige within human civilization has reached an inconceivable height.

Lin Yuan could even continuously feel the ‘faith power’ ceaselessly converging toward him.

The countless citizens of the human civilization have started to fervently worship Lin Yuan, thereby generating vast amounts of faith power.

With this faith power, Lin Yuan could easily walk the path of becoming a deity through faith.

Within the Chaos Void, there was no shortage of beings ascending to the Path Splitting Realm and even the twelfth level of Dominion Realm through this path.

With the collective power, the cultivation speed would be terrifyingly fast, virtually without any bottlenecks.

Naturally, with great power comes great risk. Presently, this path has yet to produce a Chaos Venerable.

Lin Yuan’s original Martial Tao was innately boundless in potential; he naturally wouldn’t abandon the supreme path to absorb faith power, thus cutting off future prospects.

Besides, with Lin Yuan’s Against-Heaven’s Understanding, even if he took the path of faith, it might not necessarily be a dead-end, although it was completely unnecessary.

Cultivation and evolution itself is an extremely pure personal journey. To absorb the faith power from the masses would be tantamount to actively polluting his path, becoming increasingly difficult as one progresses.

Lin Yuan’s propagation of the evolution path was not to harvest the masses but rather to use them as anchor points, preventing his own fall and losing direction.

The principles between the two are entirely different.

…

“Have you cultivated the evolution path I provided for you?”

After chatting with his parents for a while, Lin Yuan inquired.

The evolution path he referred to was naturally crafted entirely based on numerous conditions suited to his own parents.

Unfortunately, Lin Yuan’s parents lacked significant evolution talents. Even if they rely on evolution potions and longevity elixirs to continue living, weakening and distorting of their mental will is unavoidable.

During the Cosmic Era, some special beings at the Level Eleven Perfect had theoretically eternal lifespans, capable of living from the universe’s creation to its demise.

Yet why do they continue to slow their personal time flow, while thousands or even tens of thousands of years pass externally in an instant?

It’s precisely because living for too long can lead to a distortion of mental will. Without a sturdy mentality, even an uncorruptible body and soul are meaningless.

Lin Yuan was concerned his parents might end up in this situation. Though he could resurrect his parents innumerable times with his power, mental will distortion isn’t something resurrection could resolve.

“Xiaoyuan, your dad and I have been cultivating lately.”

Upon hearing this, Lu Qiong immediately gained interest, “I don’t know why, but cultivating on the evolution path you gave feels both easy and simple.”

Lin Shoucheng by the side also rarely showed a trace of a smile.

This indeed was the case.

Before, within the Cosmic Era, they tried many evolution paths, only to find them extremely hard and obscure.

“That’s good.”

Lin Yuan nodded.

How could it not be easy? How could it not be simple?

The two evolution paths Lin Yuan gave his parents were entirely tailored for them, requiring far more effort than the nine evolution paths reserved for the nine supreme beings.

“Remember to keep cultivating at all times.”

“Evolution is the only method for life’s immortality.”

Lin Yuan remarked.

He hoped his parents would not reach the point of mental distortion.

“Of course, son.”

“Now I am full of motivation for cultivation.”

Father Lin Shoucheng affirmed immediately.

Before when he cultivated, it was challenging, so naturally, he had little interest in it?

But now? Cultivating on the evolution path Lin Yuan provided felt as if he were an evolution genius, naturally giving him ample motivation.

Lin Yuan smiled upon hearing this.

“Hmm?”

“Xuanyuan and the others are looking for me?”

Lin Yuan was moved, and as he chatted with his parents, a manifestation gathered before Xuanyuan Supreme and other supreme beings.

…

“Galaxy.”

Xuanyuan Supreme, Xia Qin Supreme, and other supreme beings greeted Lin Yuan at once.

“Check out the fine wine I brewed.” Xuanyuan Supreme promptly pushed a wine glass towards Lin Yuan.
